periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the posterior towards the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated vertical-to-horizontal axis ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior point extending lower than the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately one-third of the total visible lateral torso width.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, convex curvature at the top boundary of the visible right ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow discoloration present on the white fur of the posterior-dorsal and lateral regions.
